event_markers.label: Verse 1 Start
event_markers.reason: Begin primary lyric section with higher energy drum pattern

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Elevate energy with dominant bass presence for hook

event_markers.label: Bridge Start
event_markers.reason: Introduce FX transition to create contrast and tension

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic foundation focused on aggressive trap style percussion
track_roles.bass: Deep, punchy basslines with strong low-end drive
track_roles.chords: Sparse, dark synth pads and stabs to support mood
track_roles.melody: Sharp, minimal lead lines to add tension and hook interest
track_roles.vocal: Aggressive vocal samples or rap sections for energy
track_roles.fx: Transitional effects and risers for dynamic changes

sensei_drum.brief: Generate aggressive trap drum patterns with varied hi-hats, snare rolls, and punchy kicks maintaining high energy in hooks

bass_generator.brief: Create deep, rhythmic basslines that complement the drums and emphasize the 140 BPM aggressive feel

harmony_generator.brief: Produce dark and sparse chord progressions or synth pads to support the mood without cluttering the mix

melody_generator.brief: Compose sharp and catchy lead motifs that add tension and highlight hook sections

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement pacing and energy flow ensuring balanced progression through sections

presetor.brief: Manage presets selection to match the aggressive trap style including synth sounds and drum kits

songgps.brief: Track arrangement structure and monitor energy curve to maintain dynamic interest

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed stems for mixing with focus on clarity and punch suitable for trap genre
